notes: Simplified stepped approximation of Germany's continuous quadratic Lohnsteuer formula, using the 2024 published Grundfreibetrag (EUR 11,604), progression-zone boundaries (EUR 17,005 and EUR 66,760, up to the 42% top rate) and the 45% 'Reichensteuer' threshold at EUR 277,825 (steuertipps.de, lohnsteuer-kompakt.de, Bundestag press releases, checked 2026-08-18). Flat-rate bands stand in for the real formula, which understates the true marginal curve inside each zone — this is a rough approximation, not a payroll-accurate one. Social insurance rate 19.3% (Krankenversicherung 7.3% + Pflegeversicherung 1.7% + Rentenversicherung 9.3% + Arbeitslosenversicherung 1.3%, lohn-info.de 2024) applied to a single blended contribution ceiling of EUR 90,600/year (the higher pension/unemployment cap) rather than the separate, lower health/care cap Germany actually uses — a further simplification. No church tax, no solidarity surcharge (Soli), single filer (Steuerklasse I), no dependants modelled. Rough estimate only — see docs/METHODS.md#45-net-from-gross-pay-estimation.
